romanization.latin: NFKD + strip combining marks + keep a-z/space
romanization.devanagari: IAST-inspired ASCII map then latin fold
romanization.cjk_policy: Han/kana/hangul never used as cipher alphabet; require romanized source or skip
romanization.auto: detect script → table or latin fold; CJK skipped

train_subset_rule: stratified round-robin across all non-held-out families; seed=4016; target≥400; score full holdout set

acquisition_stats.stop_reason: Legal open sources yielded 563 romanized languages after UDHR+FLORES+Tatoeba+Wikipedia fill (wiki_added=0, wiki_failed=0); stopped below 1000 rather than inventing text.
